representative_policy: Nearest raw CA-distance feature vector to its cluster centroid, with source-ID tie breaking; feature-centroid representative, not an all-model RMSD medoid. RPF/pTM/confidence never influence selection.

distance_summary.note: Pooled2000 original raw Cα-distance features; median in Å, population variance in Å². Own mask-specific summaries.

provenance.metric_policy: Raw saved float16 Angstrom CA distances cast byte-exactly to the original float32 values. No feature scaling, whitening, RPF, pTM or other confidence values in clustering. Full-construct RPF is passive coloring on every residue mask.
